title: Southwinds H12
meta_description: Welcome to Southwinds H12! This bright and beachy 2BDR condo is just steps away from the beach, and boasts access to a community pool, tennis court, and putting green.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Southwinds H12 by Avantsty!

Just moments from the sugar-white shoreline of Panama City Beach, Southwinds H12 offers a bright and breezy retreat designed for guests who want a home that feels effortless the moment they walk in. Sunshine fills the open-concept living space, where soft coastal tones, clean design, and comfortable furnishings create a sense of ease. It's the kind of place where mornings start slowly, with coffee at the dining table or curled up on the sofa as the balcony doors let in the Gulf breeze.

The living room is warm and inviting, anchored by a large Smart TV that makes movie nights feel relaxed and familiar. The full kitchen is stocked with all the essentials, making it easy to prepare casual meals after a day spent on the sand or exploring the nearby west end of PCB. Everything flows naturally here, giving the home a calm, uncluttered rhythm.

Both bedrooms are designed to feel soothing and private. The primary suite features a plush king bed and a spacious ensuite bathroom, while the second bedroom offers a comfortable queen bed with soft linens and plenty of natural light. A second full bathroom adds convenience for families or couples traveling together.

Step outside to the balcony and you'll find one of the home's most peaceful corners---a quiet perch for reading, morning stretches, or watching the last light of the day fall across the community. Beyond the front door, you'll have access to amenities that make every day a little more fun, including a community pool, tennis court, covered picnic areas, and even a mini golf course the whole group can enjoy.

Southwinds H12 sits on the desirable west end of Panama City Beach, close enough to the action yet tucked away in a spot that feels relaxed and easy. From here, you're only minutes from Pier Park's restaurants, shops, and entertainment, as well as the charming beach towns along 30A. Fresh seafood markets, local cafés, and long stretches of uncrowded coastline are all right at your fingertips.

Blending comfort, convenience, and a warm coastal atmosphere, Southwinds H12 is a place where days feel unhurried and nights feel restful---a simple, sunlit home base for making memories by the Gulf.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

Panama City Beach is known for its vibrant mix of natural beauty and coastal fun, offering travelers a rare blend of soft white sand, emerald-green water, and an easygoing atmosphere that makes every day feel like vacation. The west end, where Coastal Cove is located, offers a quieter, more relaxed stretch of beach while still placing guests close to the area's best restaurants, local cafés, family-friendly attractions, and the lively energy of Pier Park. With endless coastline to explore, water activities in every direction, and charming communities like Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach just minutes away, this area is ideal for guests seeking both adventure and a soothing Gulf-coast escape.

Local Attractions: Pier Park, Frank Brown Park, Conservation Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Camp Helen State Park, 30A Rosemary Beach, Russell-Fields Pier.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Please note that a pack-n-play is available during your stay.

Parking Details:
- Parking lot space available for up to 2 cars on a first-come, first-served basis. The mandatory $25 parking pass fee is included in the booking cost for all reservations.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

BTR #71064
